needs.title: Independent local startup
needs.need: Start and use available local functions without an account or network, with safe game integration setup.
needs.outcome: The player can configure and play locally; account transitions preserve gameplay and unrelated settings.

needs.title: Trustworthy observations
needs.need: Distinguish current admitted own-player and visible-enemy facts from unknown, stale or unsupported information.
needs.outcome: Displayed facts have valid identity, source, freshness and game-data provenance; absent evidence is never fabricated.

needs.title: Justified timely warnings
needs.need: Receive useful urgent warnings and evidence-based corrections without repeated audio or optional-service delays.
needs.outcome: Native warnings meet their acoustic and quality gates, with admitted evidence, deduplication, correction and verified critical media.

needs.title: Consistent event media
needs.need: Hear and see the correct event media from the selected verified pack and understand installation versus activation.
needs.outcome: One taxonomy and audio authority use the active verified revision; hostile packages fail safely and trust domains remain distinct.

needs.title: Readable unobtrusive match interface
needs.need: Read the field at a glance, including from peripheral vision on a second screen, and inspect by choice through an accessible interface that preserves game performance and input.
needs.outcome: The control window and passive overlay display honest states with stable layout, focus behavior and verified resource limits.

needs.title: Private local voice interaction
needs.need: Hold a remappable key to ask a local voice question, understand preparation or failure, and yield to urgent audio.
needs.outcome: One consented bounded turn remains local, meets per-language quality and timing gates, and cancels correctly under interruption.

needs.title: Controlled strategic advice
needs.need: Request local manual advice and separately decide whether narrowly defined context may reach a cloud provider.
needs.outcome: Advice uses the admitted backend and permitted projection; consent, backend or session changes fence obsolete requests and answers.

needs.title: Evidence-based memory and forgetting
needs.need: Review supported local history and concise summaries, then clear derived memory without silently deleting separate history.
needs.outcome: Local aggregates and bounded summaries retain evidence provenance; durable forgetting prevents deleted knowledge from reappearing.

needs.title: Deliberate cooperative vitals and ability sharing
needs.need: Share narrow own-player vitals, and under a separate scope own ability cooldowns, within the correct room, match and team, inspect freshness and leave predictably.
needs.outcome: Fresh consent and verified membership govern transient peer data; bounded native transport and cancellation preserve local alerts and privacy.

needs.title: Separate social and sharing permissions
needs.need: Use friends, presence and invitations without making friendship or sign-in equivalent to gameplay-sharing consent.
needs.outcome: Server-authorized social actions and transactional invitations remain independent of guest room access and explicit stats sharing.

needs.title: Explicit reliable local highlights
needs.need: Record local highlights by choice and understand actual saved coverage while recording failures remain isolated.
needs.outcome: Authenticated OBS control produces verified local clips with measured coverage, separate resource accounting and no implicit microphone or CV replacement.

needs.title: Predictable updates and capability changes
needs.need: Receive verified updates and predictable optional capability changes without losing local core, map context or control.
needs.outcome: Safe update/recovery and identical-artifact promotion have configuration evidence; future premium authority and estimated timers preserve base gameplay and data permissions.
